userClarification: 三角火焰的底边等于地面圆的直径，颜色接近前面的火苗，并且通透而非实心不透明
layout: five ground magic circles in a forward row

flame.baseWidth: equal to the full diameter of the magic circle
flame.footprint: entire circular sigil area, not a small center nozzle
flame.flow: upward tongues across the base; center tongues taller and edge tongues shorter
flame.material: airy semi-transparent orange-gold filaments with clear gaps; sigil lines and ground visible through the fire
flame.gradient: subtly deeper transparent orange below, lighter gold above; no opaque deep red mass
